div.p: Keeley Place was located off Spring Street. In 1891, the South Australian Club Hotel and Brunton's Hotel were located in Keeley Place. James Child, a fruiterer and produce merchant, was also located here in 1891. By 1920, there was a carriage and motor works located in Keeley Place. By 1930, Peters Ice Cream Company had premises in the place. In 1950, the Hambrook Plating Works were located in Keeley Place.
